name: Bodhi Windbreaker
source:
Do you remember 80's? Well, don't you worry, because our good old fashioned boy-next-door heartthrob is going to teach you all about it. He may literally be a time-capsule, but his knowledge of the era and the secrets his contents hold with blow the mind of even the most righteous 8bit enjoyer. Bodhi is here to open your mind to a simpler time, and open your hear to a love that's purer that uncut Colombian... coffee.
Likes: The 1980s
Dislikes: The 1780s

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
